scope: Detailed breakdown of playback Worker computation and elimination of redundant scene paint-order recomputation.

outcome.retainedChange: Cache the latest readonly paint-order snapshot by immutable document and its effective draw-order/visibility inputs. Reuse static tie-break metadata.
outcome.fpsInterpretation: The combined balanced-order sample median increased, but execution ranges overlap and the first ABBA set did not improve. Do not claim a fixed or consistently reproduced FPS uplift.

stageMeasurement.method: A temporary source copy adds nested synchronous Date.now timers at computation boundaries. Three 600-frame samples follow 360 warmup frames, with fixed 1/60 simulation delta. No diagnostic hooks are included in production sources/artifacts. Millisecond timer quantization is averaged across 1,800 completed frames. These diagnostic builds and their overhead are separate from uninstrumented Worker/FPS measurements.
stageMeasurement.relationToPrevious11Point3Millis: The earlier 11.3 ms was a wall-time observation in another run. Current timer-instrumented step plus encoding averaged approximately 9.3 ms before optimization. Do not rescale the components to force a match; CPU load, simulation cadence and profiling overhead differ.
stageMeasurement.hierarchy: renderPlan includes drawOrder. sceneApply includes nativeApply, glue and glueComposition. nativeApply includes transformUpdates and partMapping. runtime includes physics, motionMix, pose and effects. Inclusive rows must not be added together.
stageMeasurement.largestStage: partMapping includes lazy parent-grid interpolation and all part vertex mappings; it is not only the previously isolated warm map_vertices microbenchmark.

finding.title: Rebuilding paint-order trees and sorted arrays for unchanged ordering inputs
finding.cause: Scene traversal, flags, tie-break maps and stable sorting were repeated each produced frame. In the supplied model, 667 inspected part bindings keyed draw orders equal to their respective rest orders; their animated geometry inputs do not affect those orders.
finding.change: Prepare static metadata once, track only potentially effective ordering and visibility inputs, and retain one readonly result per document. Constant-rest grid/one-axis channels follow the existing sampler omission rule. All legacy multi-axis triangulated bindings remain dependencies because weighted constant arithmetic can alter order through floating-point rounding.
finding.tests: Constant part/group orders reuse snapshots; independent influence, keyed part/group order, ancestor visibility, mutable value maps, document revisions, Cubism ties/rounding and legacy triangulated numeric behavior remain covered.
finding.ownership: WeakMap by immutable document; one latest value/result snapshot, with no history per input or frame.
finding.maintenanceLimit: New ordering/visibility channels must be included in dependency analysis; preserve the legacy triangulation regression when modifying sampler omission rules.

wholeWorker.method: Uninstrumented built artifacts, both Workers in one Chrome, fixed 1/60 delta, 1,200 warmup frames per variant, six 300-frame ABBA samples per variant. Includes host round trip.
